display_long_description:
**Step into the race in VR — Demo Version**

*Speedway Race Clash* is a fast-paced arcade racing experience built for Meta Quest. Jump into the driver’s seat and compete in quick, intense races designed for VR.

**Play the Demo**
• 2 playable tracks
• 1 Adrenaline car
• 7 AI opponents per race
• Short races (20–30 seconds)

Experience the core gameplay, handling, and speed of the game.

 **Preview the Full Experience**
The demo lets you see additional content available in the full version:
• More tracks (up to 9 total)
• GT and F1 car classes
• Additional vehicles to unlock

Explore what’s waiting as you progress.

 **Built for VR Gameplay**
• Fast, accessible racing
• Smooth controls and responsive handling
• Designed for quick sessions

 **Continue the Race**
Finish the demo and jump into the full version to unlock all tracks, cars, and progression.

 **Start racing now and push for the lead.**
